fields.test_cases_present: partial — spec describes protocol-compliance requirements and example waveforms; no formal verification plan is included.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: Reset behavior
scenarios: reset HIGH for >= 100 cycles, all *_valid LOW.
reset deasserted synchronous with rising clock; first valid HIGH no earlier than next rising edge.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: TL-UL Get single beat
scenarios: Master Get (a_opcode=4) on channel A; slave AccessAckData (d_opcode=1) on channel D.
a_size <= log2(w) so request fits in single beat in TL-UL.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: TL-UL PutFullData single beat
scenarios: Master PutFullData (a_opcode=0) with all a_mask bits HIGH; slave AccessAck (d_opcode=0) on D.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: TL-UL PutPartialData byte-strobed
scenarios: Master PutPartialData (a_opcode=1) with sparse a_mask; slave AccessAck.
Active byte lanes within aligned a_size region.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: TL-UH ArithmeticData {MIN/MAX/MINU/MAXU/ADD}
scenarios: Atomic ADD: cover a_param=4; slave returns old value via AccessAckData.
Cover all 5 param encodings.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: TL-UH LogicalData {XOR/OR/AND/SWAP}
scenarios: Atomic XOR/OR/AND: cover all 4 param encodings.
SWAP: param=3, atomically swap operands, return old value.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: TL-UH Intent / HintAck
scenarios: PrefetchRead (a_param=0) and PrefetchWrite (a_param=1); slave HintAck (d_opcode=2).

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: TL-UH burst Get
scenarios: a_size > log2(w) so response is multi-beat AccessAckData.
Verify response beats arrive in address order, no interleaving.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: TL-UH burst PutFullData / PutPartialData
scenarios: a_size > log2(w), all beats accepted before next message can be sent.
a_address constant; a_data auto-increments per beat.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: TL-C Acquire NtoT followed by Grant + GrantAck
scenarios: Master Acquire (a_opcode=6, a_param=NtoT).
Slave Grant (d_opcode=4, d_param=toT) → Master GrantAck (e_sink=K).
Verify d_sink and e_sink match.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: TL-C Acquire NtoB followed by GrantData + GrantAck
scenarios: Master Acquire (a_opcode=6, a_param=NtoB).
Slave GrantData (d_opcode=5, d_param=toB) with payload → GrantAck.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: TL-C Probe forcing master to cap permissions
scenarios: Slave Probe (b_opcode=6, b_param=toN/toB/toT).
Master ProbeAck (c_opcode=4) or ProbeAckData (c_opcode=5) with Shrink {TtoB, TtoN, BtoN} or Report {TtoT, BtoB, NtoN}.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: TL-C voluntary Release
scenarios: Master Release (c_opcode=6, c_param=TtoB/TtoN/BtoN).
Master ReleaseData (c_opcode=7) with dirty data.
Slave ReleaseAck (d_opcode=6).

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: Channel priority enforcement
scenarios: Higher-priority message (E > D > C > B > A) must bypass lower-priority blockage.
Receiver may only lower ready according to the 4 forward-progress rules.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: Burst beats may not be interleaved
scenarios: Once a burst is in progress, no beats from another message may appear on the same channel until last beat accepted.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: c_error / d_error sticky-after-rise
scenarios: Error bit may be raised at most once per burst.
Once raised, must remain HIGH for the rest of the burst.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: Byte-lane layout little-endian naturally aligned
scenarios: (address & !(w-1)) is the address in byte lane 0.
a_mask LOW for all inactive byte lanes; HIGH for all active byte lanes (except PutPartialData).

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: Source identifier uniqueness in-flight
scenarios: Reusing inflight a_source within channel A is forbidden.
Same numeric source value may be inflight on channel A and channel C simultaneously (different namespaces).

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: Legacy-bus bridge timeout
scenarios: Bridge to AXI / AHB must include timeout; on timeout, discard request and inject TileLink error response.

derived_compliance_test_categories.name: Forward-progress 4-rule exception coverage
scenarios: Rule 1: bounded busy period.
Rule 2: blocked response on channel X lowers ready on channels <= X.
Rule 3: blocked recursive message lowers ready on channels <= X.
Rule 4: blocked sent-response lowers ready on channels <= X.

verification_methodology_notes: Industry implementations of TileLink (e.g. SiFive's Diplomacy framework, Rocket Chip, BOOM) include OOO TLMonitor protocol-checker SystemVerilog modules that bind onto each link to enforce these compliance properties.
Random-instruction Bringup tests (e.g. RISC-V architectural compatibility) exercise TL-UL/TL-UH/TL-C flows through the cache hierarchy.
Coherence-policy verification (MOESI-equivalent) is performed against the spec's permissions state machine plus a chosen policy.
